# AI Executive & Board Briefing — key ideas (one page)

## What you can now do

- Understand the AI landscape and what it means for the business model
- Ask the right oversight questions on AI strategy and risk
- Understand regulatory exposure and investment logic

## The sentences to remember

1. **What changed: the cost curve, in your numbers** — “The board question is no longer 'can AI do this'. It is 'which design, at what unit cost, with what control'.”
2. **What to fund first: portfolio view from the real engine** — “Fund two quick wins to build the muscle and one bet to matter. Everything else waits for the readiness score to move.”
3. **Risk and oversight: the one-page board view** — “You do not need to understand the model. You need to know which systems could hurt someone, and who signed for them.”
